cards.base.context.purpose.from: どの種類も受け継ぐ欄。カード自身の名前（name）は欄ではなく、カードの名前として持つ
cards.base.context.purpose.text: Fields that every kind inherits. A card's own name (name) is not a field; it is kept as the card's name

cards.base.fields.label.description.from: 画面に出す名前（日本語可）
cards.base.fields.label.description.text: The name shown in the app (any language)

cards.base.fields.description.descriptio.from: 最初の一文でそのカードが何かを言い、続けてカード全体にかかる今の決まりを書く
cards.base.fields.description.descriptio.text: Say what the card is in the first sentence, then write the current rules that apply to the whole card

cards.base.fields.tags.description.from: 自由なラベル（日本語可、カンマ不可）

cards.base.fields.metadata.description.from: 解釈しない key/value（値は文字列）。署名者・出典など
cards.base.fields.metadata.description.text: Uninterpreted key/value pairs (values are strings). Such as the signer or the source

cards.shape.context.purpose.from: データの形を持つ種類（entity・value・enum）が共に持つ欄
cards.shape.context.purpose.text: Fields shared by the kinds that hold a data shape (entity, value, enum)

cards.shape.fields.rules.description.from: [{kind, …}]。既知の kind は引数を確かめ、知らない kind はそのまま残す
cards.shape.fields.rules.description.text: [{kind, …}]. A known kind has its arguments checked; an unknown kind is kept as it is

cards.shape.fields.absentFields.descript.from: 意図して持たないフィールドと、その理由
cards.shape.fields.absentFields.descript.text: Fields that are intentionally absent, with the reason

cards.shape.fields.discriminator.descrip.from: 判別に使うフィールド名（各フィールドの variants と組）
cards.shape.fields.discriminator.descrip.text: The name of the field used to tell variants apart (goes together with variants of each field)

cards.record.context.purpose.from: フィールドの木を持つ種類（entity・value）が共に持つ行
cards.record.context.purpose.text: Rows shared by the kinds that hold a tree of fields (entity, value)

cards.record.rows.fields.fields.descript.from: その値の決まり（形式・単位・範囲、空や null の意味、指し先の補足）
cards.record.rows.fields.fields.descript.text: The rules for that value (format, unit, range, what empty or null means, notes on what it points to)

cards.record.rows.fields.fields.type.des.from: 相手の形をそのまま持つ（内包）ときは、型ではなく内包の線（connections の line: embed）で書く。線があれば型は相手になり、外すと string に戻る
cards.record.rows.fields.fields.type.des.text: To hold the partner's shape as it is (embedding), write an embed line (line: embed in connections) instead of a type. While the line exists, the type is the partner; removing the line returns the type to string

cards.record.rows.fields.fields.required.text: The key must always be present

cards.record.rows.fields.fields.nullable.from: null が正当な値であること（required とは独立）
cards.record.rows.fields.fields.nullable.text: null is a valid value (independent of required)

cards.record.rows.fields.fields.also.des.from: 本来の型のほかに受ける JSON の型（string・integer・number・boolean・object・array。array は本来の型の並びも受ける）。実例の確かめと JSON Schema・MCP のツール定義の type の並びに効く
cards.record.rows.fields.fields.also.des.text: JSON types accepted in addition to the field's own type (string, integer, number, boolean, object, array. array also accepts a list of the own type). It affects the validation of examples and the type lists (type) in JSON Schema and MCP tool definitions

cards.entity.context.purpose.from: 単位で保存・送信される記録（ID を持つ）
cards.entity.context.purpose.text: A record that is stored and sent as a unit (it has an ID)

cards.entity.context.use_when.from: データベースの行・API で送る文書など、それ自体で扱われる形を書くとき
cards.entity.context.use_when.text: When writing a shape that is handled on its own, such as a database row or a document sent through an API

cards.entity.context.not_for.from: 何かの中に入るだけの形（value）
cards.entity.context.not_for.text: A shape that only goes inside something else (value)

cards.value.context.purpose.from: 何かの中に入る形（ID を持たない）
cards.value.context.purpose.text: A shape that goes inside something else (it has no ID)

cards.value.context.use_when.from: 住所・金額のように、ほかの形の中に ref で入れて使う形を書くとき
cards.value.context.use_when.text: When writing a shape that is put inside other shapes with ref, such as an address or an amount

cards.value.fields.standalone.descriptio.from: 自分のセクションの図に、持っているカードの中に畳まずに 1 枚のカードで出す（見かけ）
cards.value.fields.standalone.descriptio.text: In the diagram of its own section, show it as a card of its own instead of folding it into the card that holds it (appearance)

cards.enum.context.purpose.from: 値の集合（open なら網羅でない）
cards.enum.context.purpose.text: A set of values (not exhaustive if open)

cards.enum.fields.open.description.from: 列挙は既知の値で、未知の値も正当
cards.enum.fields.open.description.text: The enumeration lists the known values; unknown values are also valid

cards.enum.fields.standalone.description.from: 自分のセクションの図に、持っているカードの中に畳まずに 1 枚のカードで出す（見かけ）
cards.enum.fields.standalone.description.text: In the diagram of its own section, show it as a card of its own instead of folding it into the card that holds it (appearance)

cards.enum.rows.values.fields.descriptio.from: その値が何を表すか（1 行。図のカードには出さない）
cards.enum.rows.values.fields.descriptio.text: What the value stands for (one line; not shown on the diagram's card)

cards.store.context.purpose.from: データを置く場所（テーブル・コレクション・台帳・ファイル）
cards.store.context.purpose.text: A place where data is kept (table, collection, ledger, file)

cards.store.context.use_when.from: flow の処理の行が読み書きする相手を書くとき。置くもの（記録の形）は「置く」線（connections の line: holds）で書く
cards.store.context.use_when.text: When writing what the process steps of a flow read from and write to. Write what it holds (record shapes) with a "Holds" line (line: holds in connections)

cards.instance.context.purpose.from: entity・value の形を持つ実際の値（実例）。形は線 of（MCP は value のキー of に形のパス）、値は data に形と同じ入れ子の JSON で持つ
cards.instance.context.purpose.text: An actual value (an example) of the shape of an entity or value. The shape is given by the line of (in MCP, the path of the shape goes in the of key of value), and the value is kept in data as JSON nested the same way as the shape

cards.instance.context.use_when.from: 「たとえばこういう値」を形と一緒に置くとき（API の要求と答えの例・設定の例・MCP のツール定義など）。定義のセクションに置く
cards.instance.context.use_when.text: When placing a sample value ("a value like this, for example") together with its shape (examples of API requests and responses, configuration examples, MCP tool definitions, and so on). Place it in a Definition section

cards.instance.context.not_for.from: 形そのもの（entity・value）・値の集合（enum）
cards.instance.context.not_for.text: The shape itself (entity, value) and a set of values (enum)

cards.instance.fields.data.description.from: 形（線 of の先）と同じ入れ子の JSON（キーはフィールドの名前、並びの欄は配列）
cards.instance.fields.data.description.text: JSON nested the same way as the shape (what the line of points to); keys are field names, and a field that is a list is an array

cards.table.context.purpose.from: 形（entity・value）のデータ（instance）を決まり（絞り込み・列・並べ方・要素ごとの行）で集めた表。形は線 of（MCP は value のキー of に形のパス）。文書に ![[…]] か行 card で入れる
cards.table.context.purpose.text: A table that collects the data (instance) of a shape (entity, value) by rules (filter, columns, sort order, rows per element). The shape is given by the line of (in MCP, the path of the shape goes in the of key of value). Put it into a document with ![[…]] or with a row of kind card

cards.table.context.use_when.from: データを一覧の表にして文書に入れるとき（ホストの一覧・ツールの一覧など）。定義・ドキュメント・フリーのセクションに置く
cards.table.context.use_when.text: When turning data into a table of a list and putting it into a document (a list of hosts, a list of tools, and so on). Place it in a Definition, Document or Free section

cards.table.context.not_for.from: 手で書く表（formatdoc の行 table）・データ 1 枚の欄と値（formatdoc の行 card の target にデータ）
cards.table.context.not_for.text: A table written by hand (a table row of formatdoc) and the fields and values of a single piece of data (data as the target of a card row of formatdoc)

cards.table.fields.within.description.from: 読むデータのセクション（そのセクションと中のセクション）。省けば木の中の全部
cards.table.fields.within.description.text: The section whose data is read (that section and the sections inside it). If omitted, everything in the tree

cards.table.fields.where.description.from: [{path, op, value}]。path は形の欄の名前で書く値のパス（@name・@label も）、op は eq・ne・lt・le・gt・ge・contains・exists。全部に合うデータが行になる
cards.table.fields.where.description.text: [{path, op, value}]. path is the path of a value, written with the names of the shape's fields (@name and @label also work); op is one of eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, contains, exists. Data that matches all of them becomes a row

cards.table.fields.columns.description.from: [{path, label?, show?}]。省けば @name と形の一番上の欄。[] のパスは並びの要素ごとの値を「, 」でつなぐ。show で見せ方を変える: label は列挙の値を表示名で（無ければ値）、link は値をカードのパスとして [[パス]] に（エクスポートでは相対リンク、解けなければ字のまま）。where・sort は値で比べる
cards.table.fields.columns.description.text: [{path, label?, show?}]. If omitted, @name and the first field of the shape. A path with [] joins the values of each element of a list with ", ". show changes how a value is shown: label shows an enumeration value by its display name (the value itself if there is none); link turns the value into [[path]] as a card path (a relative link in an export; left as plain text if it cannot be resolved). where and sort compare by value

cards.table.fields.sort.description.from: [{path, desc?}]。省けばデータの名前の順。値の無いものは最後
cards.table.fields.sort.description.text: [{path, desc?}]. If omitted, in the order of the data names. Data with no value comes last

cards.table.fields.unnest.description.from: 要素ごとの行にする並びの欄（値のパス）。要素の無いデータは行にならない
cards.table.fields.unnest.description.text: The list field (a value path) to turn into one row per element. Data with no elements does not become a row

cards.flow.context.purpose.from: 部品がすることと、部品をまたぐ処理の流れ。入れ物のカードで、中にノード（begin・process・run・eval・wait・join・end）のカードを置き、ノードの間を線（next・branch・else・onError・onTimeout）でつなぐ
cards.flow.context.purpose.text: What a component does, and the flow of processing that crosses components. It is a container card: put node cards (begin, process, run, eval, wait, join, end) inside it and join the nodes with lines (next, branch, else, onError, onTimeout)

cards.flow.context.use_when.from: リクエストを受ける・登録するなど、部品の入口と処理の順を書くとき
cards.flow.context.use_when.text: When writing the entry point and the order of processing of a component, such as receiving a request or registering something

cards.node.context.purpose.from: flow の中に置くノードが共に持つ欄。ノードは flow の中にだけ置け、パスは <flow のパス>.<ノードの名前>
cards.node.context.purpose.text: Fields shared by the nodes placed inside a flow. A node can be placed only inside a flow, and its path is <flow path>.<node name>

cards.node.fields.label.description.from: 箱の頭に出す見出し（日本語可）
cards.node.fields.label.description.text: The heading shown at the top of the box (any language)

cards.node.fields.description.descriptio.from: そのノードだけの補足
cards.node.fields.description.descriptio.text: A supplement for that node only

cards.begin.context.purpose.from: flow の始まり。flow に 1 つ。きっかけ（trigger）と、受けるもの（receive）を持つ
cards.begin.context.purpose.text: The start of a flow. There is one per flow. It has a trigger (trigger) and what it receives (receive)

cards.begin.context.use_when.from: flow の入口を書くとき。次へは線 next、受ける相手のフローは線 peer（何本でも。プロジェクトに無い相手は program に一緒に書ける）、受けたものを確かめる鍵は線 key（use: verify）、待つほかのフローの終わりは線 event
cards.begin.context.use_when.text: When writing the entry point of a flow. Use the line next to go on; the line peer for the flow it receives from (any number of lines; a partner that is not in the project can be written together in program); the line key for the key that verifies what it received (use: verify); and the line event for the end of another flow it waits for

cards.process.context.purpose.from: まっすぐ続く処理の行（steps）を持つノード
cards.process.context.purpose.text: A node that has process steps (steps) that continue in a straight line

cards.process.context.use_when.from: 読む・書く・署名する・確かめる・呼ぶ（プロジェクトに無いプログラム）・送る・受ける・計算する（外に出ない業務の検証や計算）を順に書くとき。行が読む・書く所は線 reads・writes、送る・受ける相手のフローは線 peer（何本でも）、鍵は線 key で、それぞれ from に行（steps[0] など）を書く。次へは線 next
cards.process.context.use_when.text: When writing, in order, steps that read, write, sign, verify, call (a program that is not in the project), send, receive and compute (business checks or calculations that stay inside). Use the lines reads and writes for where a step reads and writes, the line peer (any number) for the flows it sends to and receives from, and the line key for keys; for each of them, write the step in from (such as steps[0]). Use the line next to go on

cards.run.context.purpose.from: ほかのフローを呼んで終わりを待つノード
cards.run.context.purpose.text: A node that calls another flow and waits for it to end

cards.run.context.use_when.from: 呼ぶフローは線 runs、署名と確かめの鍵は線 key、次へは線 next、失敗したときの行き先は線 onError
cards.run.context.use_when.text: The flow to call goes in the line runs, the keys for signing and verifying in the line key, the next node in the line next, and where to go on failure in the line onError

cards.eval.context.purpose.from: 分かれ道・繰り返しのノード
cards.eval.context.purpose.text: A node for forks and loops

cards.eval.context.use_when.from: 条件ごとの行き先は線 branch（欄 when に条件の文）を当てる順に、どれにも当たらないときは線 else（必須）。繰り返しは前のノードへ戻す線
cards.eval.context.use_when.text: Write where to go for each condition as lines branch (the condition sentence goes in the field when), in the order they are tested; write where to go when none matches as the line else (required). A loop is a line that goes back to an earlier node

cards.wait.context.purpose.from: 承認・時間・ほかのフローの終わりを待つノード
cards.wait.context.purpose.text: A node that waits for an approval, for time, or for the end of another flow

cards.wait.context.use_when.from: 待つほかのフローの終わりは線 event、期限切れの行き先は線 onTimeout、次へは線 next
cards.wait.context.use_when.text: The end of another flow to wait for goes in the line event, where to go when it times out in the line onTimeout, and the next node in the line next

cards.join.context.purpose.from: 分かれた行き先がそろうのを待つノード
cards.join.context.purpose.text: A node that waits until all the branches that split off have arrived

cards.join.context.use_when.from: next を 2 本以上にして分かれた先を、同じ join のノードで合わせるとき。次へは線 next
cards.join.context.use_when.text: When the branches made by giving next two or more lines are merged at the same join node. Use the line next to go on

cards.end.context.purpose.from: flow の終わり。結果（outcome）がフローの戻り値で、呼んだ run の結果にも、ほかのフローの begin の event にもなる
cards.end.context.purpose.text: The end of a flow. The result (outcome) is the return value of the flow, and it also becomes the result of the run that called it and the event of the begin of another flow

cards.end.context.use_when.from: 返すものは欄 return（carries・program）、返す相手のフローは線 peer（何本でも。program と一緒にも書ける）、返すものに署名する鍵は線 key（use: sign）
cards.end.context.use_when.text: What it returns goes in the field return (carries, program); the flow it returns to goes in the line peer (any number of lines; can also be written together with program); the key that signs what it returns goes in the line key (use: sign)

cards.end.fields.return.label.text: What it returns to the caller

cards.end.fields.return.fields.program.l.from: 返す相手のプログラム

cards.formatdoc.context.purpose.from: 決めた書式に則って書く文書。項目ごとにパスがあり、flow やカードから項目を名指しで指せ、影響にも出る
cards.formatdoc.context.purpose.text: A document written according to a set format. Each item has a path, so a flow or a card can point at an item by name, and items also show up in impact

cards.formatdoc.context.use_when.from: 設計書・仕様書のように、項目単位で関係を把握したいとき。カードの表や図を埋め込むと、カードと一緒に変わる
cards.formatdoc.context.use_when.text: When you want to track relations item by item, as in a design document or a specification. A table or diagram of a card embedded in it changes together with the card

cards.formatdoc.context.not_for.from: 形の決まっていない文書（freedoc）・短いメモ（note）
cards.formatdoc.context.not_for.text: A document with no fixed format (freedoc) and a short memo (note)

cards.formatdoc.fields.view.label.from: セクションマップでの見え方

cards.freedoc.context.purpose.from: Markdown で書く文書。つながりは文書 1 枚まるごと（線はカードの頭から）
cards.freedoc.context.purpose.text: A document written in Markdown. Connections attach to the whole document as one (lines start from the head of the card)

cards.freedoc.context.use_when.from: Markdown でメモしたいとき・純粋な Markdown で文書を書くとき
cards.freedoc.context.use_when.text: When taking notes in Markdown, or writing a document in plain Markdown

cards.freedoc.context.not_for.from: 項目ごとに指したい文書（formatdoc）・カードのそばの短いメモ（note）
cards.freedoc.context.not_for.text: A document whose items you want to point at one by one (formatdoc) and a short memo beside a card (note)

cards.stackdoc.context.purpose.from: 版や日付ごとに積み重なる文書を 1 枚で持ち、セレクタで版を切り替えて読む。版ごとにパスがある（<カード>.<版の name>）
cards.stackdoc.context.purpose.text: Holds in one card a document that stacks up by version or date; the version being read is switched with a selector. Each version has a path (<card>.<version name>)

cards.stackdoc.context.use_when.from: 変更履歴・リリースノート・議事録のように、同じ形の節が増えていく文書を書くとき
cards.stackdoc.context.use_when.text: When writing a document that grows by sections of the same shape, such as a changelog, release notes or meeting minutes

cards.stackdoc.context.not_for.from: 項目ごとに関係を持つ設計書・仕様書（formatdoc）・1 つの本文の文書（freedoc）
cards.stackdoc.context.not_for.text: A design document or a specification whose items have relations (formatdoc) and a document with a single body (freedoc)

cards.stackdoc.fields.version.descriptio.from: 図とエディタで開いている版の name。無ければ一番上の版
cards.stackdoc.fields.version.descriptio.text: The name of the version open in the diagram and the editor. If there is none, the top version

cards.stackdoc.rows.versions.fields.name.from: パスに使う名前（例 v0_2_21。区切りの字を含む名前は、パスでは一重引用符で囲む）
cards.stackdoc.rows.versions.fields.name.text: The name used in paths (example: v0_2_21; a name holding a separator character is wrapped in single quotes in a path)

cards.stackdoc.rows.versions.fields.key..from: セレクタに出す名前（例 0.2.21）
cards.stackdoc.rows.versions.fields.key..text: The name shown in the selector (example: 0.2.21)

cards.stackdoc.rows.versions.fields.head.text: If omitted, it is the version (key). Example: 0.2.21 (2026-10-10)

cards.note.context.purpose.from: パパッと使えるメモ（付箋）。どのセクションにも置け、カードのそばに字のまま書く
cards.note.context.purpose.text: A quick memo (a sticky note). It can be placed in any section and holds plain text beside a card

cards.note.context.use_when.from: そばのカードについてのメモ・未決の問いを残すとき
cards.note.context.use_when.text: When leaving a memo about the card beside it, or an open question

cards.note.context.not_for.from: Markdown の文書（freedoc）・決めた書式の文書（formatdoc）
cards.note.context.not_for.text: A Markdown document (freedoc) and a document in a set format (formatdoc)

cards.note.fields.body.description.from: 字のまま。[[path]] はパスとして読む
cards.note.fields.body.description.text: Plain text. [[path]] is read as a path

cards.svg.context.purpose.from: SVG で描く図。図の上では箱に収まる画像として描く（中のスクリプトと外の参照は動かない）
cards.svg.context.purpose.text: A picture drawn in SVG. On a diagram it is an image fitted to its box (scripts and outside references in it do not run)

cards.svg.context.use_when.from: 画面の案・図のように、文では伝わりにくい静止した見た目を置くとき
cards.svg.context.use_when.text: When placing a still look that words hardly convey, such as a screen idea or a figure

cards.svg.context.not_for.from: 動きや組みのある画面（html）・Mermaid で書ける図（freedoc の図）
cards.svg.context.not_for.text: A screen with movement or layout (html) and a figure Mermaid can write (a diagram in a freedoc)

cards.svg.fields.body.description.from: SVG（XML として読め、根が svg の要素）
cards.svg.fields.body.description.text: SVG (reads as XML, with an svg element at its root)

cards.svg.fields.headerPlace.description.from: マップで見出しの札（名前 | 表示名 | 種類）を出す部品の角。hidden ならマップに出さない
cards.svg.fields.headerPlace.description.text: The corner of the part the map shows its header tag (name | label | kind) at. hidden keeps it off the map

cards.svg.fields.note.description.from: モックで部品の角に付箋で重ねる文字（部品に付いて動き、はめ込んでも出る。エクスポートには出ない）
cards.svg.fields.note.description.text: Text laid over a corner of the part as a sticky note on the mock (it moves with the part and shows where the part is framed; never exported)

cards.svg.fields.notePlace.description.from: 付箋を置く部品の角。hidden ならモックに出さない
cards.svg.fields.notePlace.description.text: The corner of the part the note sits at. hidden keeps it off the mock

cards.svg.fields.reviewedAt.description.from: アクション「見直した」（reviewed）が書く時刻。部品を書いたことになり、見直しの印が消える
cards.svg.fields.reviewedAt.description.text: When the action Reviewed (reviewed) was used. Writing it counts as writing the part, which clears its review mark

cards.html.context.purpose.from: HTML と CSS で組む画面。図の上では箱の幅で組んだページとして描く（スクリプトと外の読み込みは動かない。画像は data: だけ）
cards.html.context.purpose.text: A screen laid out in HTML and CSS. On a diagram it is a page laid out at its box's width (scripts and outside loads do not run; images only as data:)

cards.html.context.use_when.from: 画面の案のように、組みや文字の流れのある見た目を置くとき。ページの中の sb-nav:<パス> のリンクはアプリの中でそのカードを開く
cards.html.context.use_when.text: When placing a look with layout and flowing text, such as a screen idea. A link sb-nav:<path> in the page opens that card in the app

cards.html.context.not_for.text: A still figure (svg) and a document (freedoc)

cards.html.fields.body.description.from: HTML（断片でも 1 枚のページでもよい）
cards.html.fields.body.description.text: HTML (a fragment or a whole page)

cards.html.fields.headerPlace.descriptio.from: マップで見出しの札（名前 | 表示名 | 種類）を出す部品の角。hidden ならマップに出さない
cards.html.fields.headerPlace.descriptio.text: The corner of the part the map shows its header tag (name | label | kind) at. hidden keeps it off the map

cards.html.fields.note.description.from: モックで部品の角に付箋で重ねる文字（部品に付いて動き、はめ込んでも出る。エクスポートには出ない）
cards.html.fields.note.description.text: Text laid over a corner of the part as a sticky note on the mock (it moves with the part and shows where the part is framed; never exported)

cards.html.fields.notePlace.description.from: 付箋を置く部品の角。hidden ならモックに出さない
cards.html.fields.notePlace.description.text: The corner of the part the note sits at. hidden keeps it off the mock

cards.html.fields.reviewedAt.description.from: アクション「見直した」（reviewed）が書く時刻。部品を書いたことになり、見直しの印が消える
cards.html.fields.reviewedAt.description.text: When the action Reviewed (reviewed) was used. Writing it counts as writing the part, which clears its review mark

cards.frame.context.purpose.from: UI のセクションに置き、ほかの UI のセクションのモックを自分の箱に 1:1 ではめ込むカード（はみ出す所は切る）
cards.frame.context.purpose.text: A card in a ui section that puts another ui section's mock into its box at 1:1 (what overflows the box is clipped)

cards.frame.context.use_when.from: ヘッダー・サイドバーのように、いくつもの画面で使う部品の組をはめ込むとき（同じセクションを何枚ものはめ込みで使える）
cards.frame.context.use_when.text: When putting in a set of parts many screens use, such as a header or a sidebar (one section can be used by many frames)

cards.frame.context.not_for.from: 部品そのもの（html・svg）・ほかのセクションのカードを指すこと（カードゴースト）
cards.frame.context.not_for.text: The parts themselves (html, svg) and pointing at a card of another section (card ghost)

cards.frame.fields.target.description.from: はめ込む UI のセクションのパス（UI/Header のように木の頭から。id で覚えて改名・移動に付いて行く）。自分のいるセクションと、たどると自分のいるセクションに戻るものは指せない
cards.frame.fields.target.description.text: The path of the ui section to put in (from the top of the tree, like UI/Header; held by id, so it follows a rename or a move). It cannot be its own section, nor one whose frames lead back to its own section

cards.frame.fields.headerPlace.descripti.from: マップで見出しの札（名前 | 表示名 | 種類）を出す部品の角。hidden ならマップに出さない
cards.frame.fields.headerPlace.descripti.text: The corner of the part the map shows its header tag (name | label | kind) at. hidden keeps it off the map

cards.frame.fields.note.description.from: モックで部品の角に付箋で重ねる文字（部品に付いて動き、はめ込んでも出る。エクスポートには出ない）
cards.frame.fields.note.description.text: Text laid over a corner of the part as a sticky note on the mock (it moves with the part and shows where the part is framed; never exported)

cards.frame.fields.notePlace.description.from: 付箋を置く部品の角。hidden ならモックに出さない
cards.frame.fields.notePlace.description.text: The corner of the part the note sits at. hidden keeps it off the mock

cards.frame.fields.reviewedAt.descriptio.from: アクション「見直した」（reviewed）が書く時刻。部品を書いたことになり、見直しの印が消える
cards.frame.fields.reviewedAt.descriptio.text: When the action Reviewed (reviewed) was used. Writing it counts as writing the part, which clears its review mark

cards.goal.context.purpose.from: 目標。入れ物のカードで、小目標（goal）とタスク（task）を中に置き、終わったら完了にする。進み具合は、中の task の done と、中の goal が完了かで数える
cards.goal.context.purpose.text: A goal. It is a container card: put sub-goals (goal) and tasks (task) inside it, and set its status to 完了 when it is finished. Progress is counted from the done of the tasks inside and from whether the goals inside are 完了

cards.goal.context.use_when.from: やることを束ねて進み具合を見たいとき。中の task の作業の順は goal の中の並び（card_update の position）
cards.goal.context.use_when.text: When you want to bundle to-dos and watch the progress. The order of work of the tasks inside is the order within the goal (position of card_update)

cards.goal.fields.status.description.from: 目標がどこまで進んだか
cards.goal.fields.status.description.text: How far the goal has progressed

cards.goal.fields.priority.description.from: どれだけ急ぐか（書かなければ決めていない）。予定の順（表示名の番号）とは別に持つ
cards.goal.fields.priority.description.text: How urgent it is (if not written, it is undecided). Kept separately from the planned order (the number in the display name)

cards.goal.fields.MR.description.from: 出した merge request の番号
cards.goal.fields.MR.description.text: The number of the merge request that was submitted

cards.goal.fields.body.description.text: The finished form and the order of work

cards.task.context.purpose.from: タスク。本文に仕様・どこまで進んだか・経緯を書き、終わったらチェックする
cards.task.context.purpose.text: A task. Write the specification, how far it has progressed and the background in the body, and check it when it is finished

cards.task.context.use_when.from: goal の中の 1 つのやること。作業の順は goal の中の並び（card_update の position。画面は番号 1・2・3… で出す）。細かい確かめは本文の Markdown のチェックリスト（- [ ]）で書く
cards.task.context.use_when.text: One to-do inside a goal. The order of work is the order within the goal (position of card_update; the app shows it as the numbers 1, 2, 3 …). Write detailed checks as a Markdown checklist (- [ ]) in the body

cards.task.fields.body.description.from: 仕様・どこまで進んだか・経緯
cards.task.fields.body.description.text: The specification, how far it has progressed, and the background

cards.section.context.purpose.from: ほかのセクションのうち、線が届く所だけを 1 枚にまとめたカード。アプリがセクションの図に描く（置いてあるカードではない）
cards.section.context.purpose.text: A card that gathers, into one, only the parts of other sections that lines reach. The app draws it in a section's diagram (it is not a card that has been placed)

cards.section.context.use_when.from: 読むだけ。図の上でセクションゴーストを見たとき、その中のカードはセクションのパスで読む
cards.section.context.use_when.text: Read only. When you see a section ghost on a diagram, read the cards inside it by the path of the section

cards.section.context.not_for.from: 作るもの（アプリが図に描くカードなので、card_create では作れない）
cards.section.context.not_for.text: Something to create (it is a card the app draws on a diagram, so it cannot be created with card_create)

cards.file.context.purpose.from: 作業ディレクトリのファイル。コアが作業ディレクトリを読んで、main と各 branch の作業ディレクトリのセクションの中に作る。名前と表示名はファイルの名前そのまま（パスでは区切りの字を含む名前を一重引用符で囲む: repo/docs:'CardKinds.md'）、filePath は作業ディレクトリからのパス
cards.file.context.purpose.text: A file in a working directory. The core reads the working directory and creates it inside the working directory's section of main and every branch. Its name and display name are the file's name as it is (in a path, a name holding a separator character is wrapped in single quotes: repo/docs:'CardKinds.md'), and filePath is the path from the working directory

cards.file.context.use_when.from: 読むだけ。main・branch のカードから「実装」の線で指す（相手は木の中のパス: repo/src:'a.rs'）
cards.file.context.use_when.text: Read only. Point at it from a card in main or a branch with an "Implemented by" line (the partner is its path in the tree: repo/src:'a.rs')

cards.file.context.not_for.from: 書くもの（作業ディレクトリを読み直すと作り直される。card_create では作れない）
cards.file.context.not_for.text: Something to write (it is recreated when the working directory is read again; it cannot be created with card_create)

cards.file.fields.filePath.description.from: 作業ディレクトリからのパス（/ で区切る。カードのパス path とは別）
cards.file.fields.filePath.description.text: The path from the working directory (separated by /; not the same as the card's path, path)

cards.file.fields.language.description.from: 拡張子かファイルの名前と、作業ディレクトリの parsers から決めた言語の id（rust・swift など。言語が無ければ書かない）
cards.file.fields.language.description.text: The id of the language decided from the extension or the file's name and the working directory's parsers (rust, swift and so on; left out when there is none)

cards.symbol.context.purpose.from: ファイルの中の関数や型。読むたびにファイルから作り、保存しない（パスはファイルのパスに続ける: repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total）
cards.symbol.context.purpose.text: A function or type in a file. Made from the file each time it is read, never kept (its path goes on from the file's: repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total)

cards.symbol.context.use_when.from: 読むだけ。関数 1 つのコードを card_read で読むとき・main・branch のカードから「実装」の線で指すとき（相手は repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total）
cards.symbol.context.use_when.text: Read only. Read the code of one function with card_read, or point at it from a card in main or a branch with an "Implemented by" line (the partner is repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total)

cards.symbol.context.not_for.from: 書くもの（ファイルから作るので、card_create では作れない）
cards.symbol.context.not_for.text: Something to write (it is made from the file; it cannot be created with card_create)

cards.symbol.fields.of.description.from: どの言語でも同じ分け方（関数・メソッド・型・モジュール・定数・マクロ）。画面の札はこれから
cards.symbol.fields.of.description.text: Sorted the same way in every language (function, method, type, module, constant, macro). The screen's badge comes from it

cards.symbol.fields.word.description.from: その言語での呼び方（fn・struct・protocol・extension・class など）
cards.symbol.fields.word.description.text: What the language calls it (fn, struct, protocol, extension, class and so on)

cards.symbol.fields.language.description.from: 言語の id（rust・swift など）
cards.symbol.fields.language.description.text: The language's id (rust, swift and so on)

cards.ghost.context.purpose.from: ほかのセクションのカード（かカードゴースト）を指すショートカット（macOS のエイリアス）。本物は元の場所に 1 つだけで、カードゴーストは置いたセクションに自分の名前を持ち、指す先を id で覚えて改名・移動に付いて行く
cards.ghost.context.purpose.text: A shortcut (like a macOS alias) that points to a card in another section (or to another card ghost). The real card exists only once, in its original place; a card ghost has its own name in the section where it is placed, and it remembers what it points to by id, so it follows renames and moves

cards.ghost.context.use_when.from: ほかのセクションのカードを、このセクションの図に丸ごと出したいとき・このセクションの中から名前だけで書きたいとき
cards.ghost.context.use_when.text: When you want to show a card of another section whole in this section's diagram, or to write it by name only from inside this section

cards.ghost.context.not_for.from: カードの写し（中身は本物にだけあり、カードゴーストを通して読み書きすると本物が変わる）
cards.ghost.context.not_for.text: A copy of a card (the content exists only in the real card, and reading or writing through the card ghost changes the real card)

cards.ghost.fields.target.description.from: 本物のカードか、ほかのカードゴーストのパス（同じセクションのものは指せない）。付け替えは、たどった本物が今と同じ種類のときだけ
cards.ghost.fields.target.description.text: The path of a real card or of another card ghost (one in the same section cannot be pointed at). It can be repointed only when the real card it leads to is of the same kind as the current one

sections.document.description.from: 文書（freedoc・formatdoc・stackdoc）と、そのそばの付箋（note）・図（svg・html）を置く
sections.document.description.text: Holds documents (freedoc, formatdoc, stackdoc) and the sticky notes (note) and pictures (svg, html) beside them

sections.document.context.use_when.from: 仕様書・設計書・読み方の文書を書くとき
sections.document.context.use_when.text: When writing specifications, design documents and reading guides

sections.document.context.not_for.from: データの形（schema）・処理の流れ（chart）
sections.document.context.not_for.text: Data shapes (schema) and flows of processing (chart)

sections.ui.description.from: 画面の案を部品（html・svg）とはめ込み（frame）で組む。付箋（note）も置ける。開くとセクションマップに、部品を組み上げた画面と同じ見た目で描く
sections.ui.description.text: A screen mock built from parts (html, svg) and frames (frame); sticky notes (note) too. It opens on its Section map, each part drawn as the assembled screen draws it

sections.ui.context.use_when.from: 画面の見え方を、部品を置いて組み上げた画面そのもので決めるとき。いくつもの画面で使う組は別の UI のセクションにして、はめ込みで使う
sections.ui.context.use_when.text: When deciding how a screen looks by the screen itself, built from parts put in place. A set many screens use goes in a ui section of its own and is used through frames

sections.ui.context.not_for.from: 文書のそばの図（document の svg・html）
sections.ui.context.not_for.text: Pictures beside a document (svg, html in a document section)

sections.schema.description.from: データの形（entity・value・enum）と置き場（store）を置く
sections.schema.description.text: Holds data shapes (entity, value, enum) and stores (store)

sections.schema.context.use_when.from: 記録・値の形・列挙と、それを置く所を書くとき。部品ごとに中のセクションに分ける
sections.schema.context.use_when.text: When writing records, value shapes and enumerations, and the places that hold them. Split them into inner sections by component

sections.definition.description.from: 外へ約束する定義（API の引数・設定ファイル・メッセージの形）を、形（entity・value・enum・store）とデータ（instance）・表（table）で一緒に置く
sections.definition.description.text: Holds definitions promised to the outside (the shapes of API arguments, configuration files and messages) as shapes (entity, value, enum, store) together with data (instance) and tables (table)

sections.definition.context.use_when.from: API の引数・設定ファイル・メッセージの形のように外へ約束する定義を、形と実例（データ）で一緒に持つとき。部品ごとに中のセクションに分ける
sections.definition.context.use_when.text: When keeping a definition promised to the outside, such as the shape of API arguments, a configuration file or a message, as its shape together with examples (data). Split them into inner sections by component

sections.definition.context.not_for.from: 外へ約束しない記録の形と置き場（schema）・処理の流れ（chart）
sections.definition.context.not_for.text: Shapes of records and stores not promised to the outside (schema) and flows of processing (chart)

sections.chart.description.from: 部品がすることと処理の流れ（flow）を置く
sections.chart.description.text: Holds what components do and the flows of processing (flow)

sections.chart.context.use_when.from: 部品の入口と処理の順を flow で書くとき。部品ごとに中のセクションに分ける
sections.chart.context.use_when.text: When writing the entry point and the order of processing of a component as a flow. Split them into inner sections by component

sections.free.description.from: どの種類のカードも置ける下書きの場所。合うセクションへ移して整理する
sections.free.description.text: A draft area where cards of any kind can be put. Sort them out by moving them to a section that fits

sections.free.context.use_when.from: 置き場の決まらないカードをいったん置くとき。あとで合うセクションへ移す
sections.free.context.use_when.text: When putting down, for the time being, a card whose place is not decided. Move it later to a section that fits

sections.free.context.not_for.from: 整理したあとのカードの置き場
sections.free.context.not_for.text: The place for cards after they have been sorted out

sections.goals.description.from: プロジェクトボードの目標（goal）とタスク（task）を置く
sections.goals.description.text: Holds the goals (goal) and tasks (task) of the Project Board

sections.goals.context.use_when.from: やることを目標とタスクで持つとき（ボードの根の直下）
sections.goals.context.use_when.text: When keeping to-dos as goals and tasks (directly under the root of the board)

sections.goals.context.not_for.from: 仕様と設計（main に書く）

sections.complete.description.from: ボードの Goals の中の、完了した目標と済んだタスクの置き場。カードのアクション（finish・done）がここへ移す
sections.complete.description.text: Inside the board's Goals, where finished goals and done tasks go. The card actions (finish, done) move them here

sections.complete.context.use_when.from: 読むとき・済んだものを見返すとき（Goals の中に 1 つ。名前は変えてよい）
sections.complete.context.use_when.text: When reading or looking back at what is finished (one inside Goals; it may be renamed)

sections.complete.context.not_for.from: 進めている目標（Goals に置く）
sections.complete.context.not_for.text: Goals in progress (put them in Goals)

sections.cancelled.description.from: ボードの Goals の中の、打ち切った目標とタスクの置き場。カードのアクション（cancel）がここへ移す
sections.cancelled.description.text: Inside the board's Goals, where cancelled goals and tasks go. The card action cancel moves them here

sections.cancelled.context.use_when.from: 読むとき・打ち切ったものを見返すとき（Goals の中に 1 つ。名前は変えてよい）
sections.cancelled.context.use_when.text: When reading or looking back at what was cancelled (one inside Goals; it may be renamed)

sections.cancelled.context.not_for.from: 進めている目標（Goals に置く）
sections.cancelled.context.not_for.text: Goals in progress (put them in Goals)

sections.workdir.description.from: 作業ディレクトリ。コアがこの機械の結び付けたフォルダを読み、中のディレクトリをセクション（directory）、ファイルをカード（file）として作る。中身はどの branch でも同じで、読むだけ。置けるのはメモ（note）だけ
sections.workdir.description.text: A working directory. The core reads the folder bound to it on this machine and makes the directories in it sections (directory) and the files cards (file). What is in it is the same in every branch, and read only. Only notes can be put in it

sections.workdir.context.use_when.from: コードのファイルを読むとき・カードから「実装」の線でファイルを指すとき・フォルダのそばにメモを置くとき（プロジェクトの木に並べると作業ディレクトリができる）
sections.workdir.context.use_when.text: When reading the files of the code, pointing at a file from a card with an "Implemented by" line, or putting a note beside a folder (listing it in the project tree makes the working directory)

sections.workdir.context.not_for.from: 書くもの（ディレクトリとファイルはコアが読んで作る。中にセクションは作れない）
sections.workdir.context.not_for.text: Something to write (the core reads and makes the directories and files; no section can be created inside it)

sections.directory.description.from: 作業ディレクトリの中のディレクトリ。コアが作業ディレクトリのセクションの中に、読んだフォルダから作る（根の直下には置かない）
sections.directory.description.text: A directory inside a working directory. The core makes it inside the working directory's section from the folder it read (it is not placed directly under a root)

sections.directory.context.use_when.from: 読むだけ。ファイルのカードへ「実装」の線を引くとき・フォルダのそばにメモを置くとき
sections.directory.context.use_when.text: Read only. When drawing an "Implemented by" line to a file card, or putting a note beside a folder

sections.directory.context.not_for.from: 作るもの（コアが作業ディレクトリを読んで作る）
sections.directory.context.not_for.text: Something to create (the core makes it by reading the working directory)

lines.embed.description.from: 欄の型が相手になる（相手の形をそのまま持つ）。線を外すと欄の型は string に戻る
lines.embed.description.text: The type of the field becomes the partner (it holds the partner's shape as it is). Removing the line returns the type of the field to string

lines.embed.context.use_when.from: 住所や金額のように、相手の形を欄にそのまま持つとき
lines.embed.context.use_when.text: When a field holds the partner's shape as it is, such as an address or an amount

lines.embed.context.not_for.from: 相手を ID で指すだけのとき（points）
lines.embed.context.not_for.text: When it only points at the partner by ID (points)

lines.points.description.from: 欄の値が相手の ID。型は変わらない
lines.points.description.text: The value of the field is the partner's ID. The type does not change

lines.points.context.use_when.from: 欄が相手の記録の ID を持つとき（外部キー）
lines.points.context.use_when.text: When a field holds the ID of the partner's record (a foreign key)

lines.points.context.not_for.text: When it holds the partner's shape (embed)

lines.points.fields.discriminatedBy.labe.from: 相手の種類名が入っている欄
lines.points.fields.discriminatedBy.labe.text: Field that holds the kind name of the partner

lines.points.fields.discriminatedBy.desc.from: 書くと相手（to）は書かず、同じセクションの、この欄の値を const で持つカードが相手の候補になる
lines.points.fields.discriminatedBy.desc.text: If you write this, leave out the partner (to); the candidates for the partner are the cards in the same section that hold the value of this field as a const

lines.points.fields.discriminatorField.l.from: 相手の側で const を持つ欄
lines.points.fields.discriminatorField.l.text: Field that holds the const on the partner's side

lines.points.fields.discriminatorField.d.from: discriminatedBy と組。省けば discriminatedBy と同じ名前
lines.points.fields.discriminatorField.d.text: Goes together with discriminatedBy. If omitted, it has the same name as discriminatedBy

lines.link.description.from: 型に関係しない、つながりだけの線（task からほかの task・goal へ、欄から使ってよい値の一覧のある欄へ、など。ボードのカードから main のカードへもフルパスで引ける（直す予定の仕様・設計へ。逆向きと branch にしか無いカードへは引けない））
lines.link.description.text: A line that only connects and has nothing to do with types (from a task to another task or goal, from a field to a field that has a list of values it may use, and so on. A card on the board can also reach a card in main by its full path (to a specification or design that is going to be changed; it cannot reach in the reverse direction, or a card that exists only in a branch))

lines.link.context.use_when.from: 型に関係なく、つながりだけを言いたいとき。task から仕様のカードへも
lines.link.context.use_when.text: When you only want to state a connection, regardless of types. Also from a task to a specification card

lines.link.context.not_for.from: 本文の [[ ]] のつながり（mentions。本文から拾う）
lines.link.context.not_for.text: Connections made by [[ ]] in a body (mentions; picked up from the body)

lines.holds.description.text: The record shape that a store holds

lines.holds.context.use_when.from: store に置く記録の形を言うとき
lines.holds.context.use_when.text: When stating the record shape that a store holds

lines.of.description.from: データ（instance）がどの形（entity・value）の実例か、表（table）がどの形のデータを集めるか。MCP は value のキー of で書き、connections には書かない
lines.of.description.text: Which shape (entity, value) a piece of data (instance) is an example of, and which shape's data a table collects. In MCP, write it with the of key of value; do not write it in connections

lines.of.context.use_when.from: 読むだけ。データと表の形は value のキー of で書く
lines.of.context.use_when.text: Read only. The shape of data and tables is written with the of key of value

lines.notes.description.from: flow の決まりを書いた note・freedoc・formatdoc か、formatdoc の項目
lines.notes.description.text: A note, freedoc or formatdoc that states the rules of a flow, or an item of a formatdoc

lines.notes.context.use_when.from: flow の決まりを書いた文書や項目をつなぐとき
lines.notes.context.use_when.text: When connecting a document or an item that states the rules of a flow

lines.implementedBy.description.from: 仕様・設計のカード（とその欄・行・ノード）から、それを実装している作業ディレクトリのファイルか、その中の関数と型へ。main と branch のカードから引け、相手は to に木の中のパス（repo/src:'a.rs'・repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total。まだ無いファイルと関数も書ける）
lines.implementedBy.description.text: From a specification or design card (and its fields, rows and nodes) to the file in a working directory that implements it, or to a function or type inside it. It can be drawn from cards in main and branches, and the partner is written in to as its path in the tree (repo/src:'a.rs', repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total; a file or function that does not exist yet can be written too)

lines.implementedBy.context.use_when.from: 仕様・設計を実装しているファイルや関数を言うとき
lines.implementedBy.context.use_when.text: When stating the file or the function that implements a specification or design

lines.mentions.description.from: note と文書の本文の [[ ]] が指す所。本文から拾うので connections には書かない
lines.mentions.description.text: What [[ ]] in the body of a note or document points at. It is picked up from the body, so it is not written in connections

lines.mentions.context.use_when.from: 読むだけ。本文の [[ ]] から拾うので書かない
lines.mentions.context.use_when.text: Read only. It is picked up from [[ ]] in the body, so do not write it

lines.next.description.from: ノードの次の行き先。2 本以上で並列に分かれ、同じ合流（join）のノードで合わさる
lines.next.description.text: Where a node goes next. Two or more lines split into parallel paths, which merge at the same join node

lines.next.context.use_when.from: ノードの次の行き先を言うとき。2 本以上で並列に分かれる
lines.next.context.use_when.text: When stating where a node goes next. Two or more lines split into parallel paths

lines.branch.description.from: 判断（eval）の分かれ道: 条件（欄 when）が当たるときの行き先。並びの順に当てる
lines.branch.description.text: A fork of an eval node: where to go when the condition (field when) matches. The conditions are tested in the order of the list

lines.branch.context.use_when.from: 判断の条件ごとの行き先を、当てる順に
lines.branch.context.use_when.text: Where to go for each condition of an eval node, in the order they are tested

lines.branch.fields.when.description.from: 文字で書き、評価しない。[[パス]] と列挙の値で書ける
lines.branch.fields.when.description.text: Written as text and not evaluated. It can be written with [[path]] and enumeration values

lines.else.description.from: 判断（eval）のどの条件にも当たらないときの行き先（判断に必須）
lines.else.description.text: Where to go when none of the conditions of an eval node matches (required for an eval node)

lines.else.context.use_when.from: 判断のどの条件にも当たらないときの行き先（判断に必須）
lines.else.context.use_when.text: Where to go when none of the conditions of an eval node matches (required for an eval node)

lines.onError.description.from: 実行（run）が失敗したときの行き先
lines.onError.description.text: Where to go when a run node fails

lines.onError.context.use_when.from: 実行が失敗したときの行き先
lines.onError.context.use_when.text: Where to go when a run node fails

lines.onTimeout.description.from: 待つ（wait）が期限（timeout）を過ぎたときの行き先
lines.onTimeout.description.text: Where to go when a wait node passes its timeout

lines.onTimeout.context.use_when.from: 待つが期限を過ぎたときの行き先
lines.onTimeout.context.use_when.text: Where to go when a wait node passes its timeout

lines.runs.description.from: 実行（run）が呼んで終わりを待つフロー
lines.runs.description.text: The flow that a run node calls and waits for until it ends

lines.runs.context.use_when.from: 実行が呼ぶフローを言うとき
lines.runs.context.use_when.text: When stating the flow that a run node calls

lines.event.description.from: 開始（trigger: event）や待つ（for: event）が待つ、ほかのフローの終わり（欄 outcome にその結果）
lines.event.description.text: The end of another flow that a begin node (trigger: event) or a wait node (for: event) waits for (the field outcome holds its result)

lines.event.context.use_when.from: 開始や待つが、ほかのフローの終わりを待つとき
lines.event.context.use_when.text: When a begin node or a wait node waits for the end of another flow

lines.reads.description.from: 処理の行（read）が読む所。from に行（steps[0] など）
lines.reads.description.text: Where a process step (read) reads from. Write the step in from (such as steps[0])

lines.reads.context.use_when.from: 処理の行が読む所を言うとき（from に行）
lines.reads.context.use_when.text: When stating where a process step reads from (the step goes in from)

lines.writes.description.from: 処理の行（write）が書く所。from に行（steps[0] など）
lines.writes.description.text: Where a process step (write) writes to. Write the step in from (such as steps[0])

lines.writes.context.use_when.from: 処理の行が書く所を言うとき（from に行）
lines.writes.context.use_when.text: When stating where a process step writes to (the step goes in from)

lines.peer.description.from: 送る・受ける相手のフロー: 処理の行（send・receive）、開始の受ける（trigger: receive）、終了の返す相手。何本でも引け（同じ所から同じ flow へは 1 本）、program と一緒にも書ける
lines.peer.description.text: The partner flow to send to or receive from: a process step (send, receive), the receive of a begin node (trigger: receive), and the return partner of an end node. Any number of lines can be drawn (one from the same place to the same flow), and it can be written together with program

lines.peer.context.use_when.from: 送る・受ける・返す相手のフローを言うとき
lines.peer.context.use_when.text: When stating the partner flow to send to, receive from or return to

lines.key.description.from: 署名する（use: sign）・確かめる（use: verify）鍵: 処理の行（sign・verify の鍵、send・call の署名、receive・call の確かめ）、実行の渡すものと受けたもの、開始の受けたもの、終了の返すもの
lines.key.description.text: The key that signs (use: sign) or verifies (use: verify): a process step (the key of sign and verify, the signature of send and call, the verification of receive and call), what a run node passes on and what it received, what a begin node received, and what an end node returns

lines.key.context.use_when.from: 署名する鍵・確かめる鍵を言うとき（欄 use）
lines.key.context.use_when.text: When stating a key that signs or a key that verifies (field use)

lines.key.fields.use.description.from: sign は署名を作る鍵（秘密鍵かそのハンドル）、verify は署名を確かめる鍵（公開鍵）
lines.key.fields.use.description.text: sign is the key that makes a signature (a private key or its handle); verify is the key that checks a signature (a public key)

actions.start.description.from: SB の branch を作り（名前は value の branch。省けばカードの名前から: McpPictures → mcp-pictures）、workBranch にその名前、status に進行中を書く。未着手の goal と、進行中で workBranch の branch が無い goal で使える
actions.start.description.text: Makes the SB branch (named by value's branch; left out, made from the card's name: McpPictures → mcp-pictures), and writes its name in workBranch and 進行中 (in progress) in status. For a goal not started, and one in progress whose workBranch names no branch

actions.finish.description.from: status を完了に、workBranch を空にし、ボードの完了のセクションへ移す（中のカードも）。workBranch の branch に main へ入っていない変更か出している MR があれば断る。変更の無い branch は消す
actions.finish.description.text: Sets status to 完了 (complete), empties workBranch and moves the goal into the board's Complete section (the cards inside go with it). Refused while workBranch's branch has changes not in main or an open MR. A branch with no changes is deleted

actions.cancel.description.from: status を打ち切りに、workBranch を空にし、ボードの打ち切りのセクションへ移す。workBranch の branch は、変更が無ければ消し、変更が残れば value の discard: true のときだけ消す
actions.cancel.description.text: Sets status to 打ち切り (cancelled), empties workBranch and moves the goal into the board's Cancelled section. workBranch's branch is deleted when it has no changes, and with changes only when value has discard: true

actions.done.description.from: done を入れる。goal の外に置いた task はボードの完了のセクションへ移す
actions.done.description.text: Checks done. A task outside any goal is moved into the board's Complete section

actions.read.description.from: 作業ディレクトリのセクションのアクション。この機械で結び付けたフォルダを読み直し、中のディレクトリとファイルを今の姿にする（プロジェクトの中身は変えない）。フォルダを結び付けていて、読み方が none でないときに使える
actions.read.description.text: An action of a working directory's section. Reads the folder bound on this machine again and brings the directories and files in it up to how they are now (the project's content does not change). Usable when a folder is bound and it is not read as none

actions.reviewed.description.from: 部品（html・svg・frame）の reviewedAt に今の時刻を書き、部品を書いたことにして見直しの印を消す。作業ディレクトリのファイルへ引いた線（implementedBy など）を持つカードでは、変わった線と覚えていない線のコードを今の形で覚え直す（コミットにならない）。印のあるカードで使える
actions.reviewed.description.text: Writes the current time to the part's (html, svg, frame) reviewedAt, which counts as writing the part and clears its review mark; on a card with lines to working-directory files (implementedBy and the like), records the code of the changed and unrecorded lines as it is now (no commit). Usable on a card with a mark
